{{See also|SiPEED Lichee Module 4A|SiPEED|List of SBCs}}
===Hardware specification=== *CPU: [[Alibaba T-Head]] TH1520 Xuantie C910 @1.85GHz :SoC: Quad-Core RISC-V (RV64GC) 64-bit :NPU: 4.0 TOPS @1.0GHz *GPU: ''Imagination'' BXM-4-64 @800MHz :(OpenGL ES3.1, OpenVG 1.2, Vulkan 1.2) :VPU: H.264/H.265 decoder up to 4Kp75, :H.265 encoder up to 4Kp40 *Storage: 128GB (eMMC 5.1) Flash, :TF card (max.1TB)/MMC card slot *Memory: 16GB (LPDDR4X) SDRAM (''[[Rayson]]'') *Wi-Fi: [[Realtek]] RTL8723DS, SDIO 2.0 (module) :802.11bgn 1T1R (2.4GHz), BT 4.2 BLE *USB: 4x USB 3.0, 1x USB 2.0 (Device) ports *Network: 2x GbE ports *GPIO: 1x 20-pin headers *Power: 12V/2A via barrel or optional 802.3at PoE
